crossRefs.note: Not everyone who says to me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ will enter into the Kingdom of Heaven; but he who does the will of my Father…
If anyone desires to do his will, he will know about the teaching, whether it is from God, or if I am speaking from…
But he who looks into the perfect law of freedom and continues, not being a hearer who forgets, but a doer of the work…
The world is passing away with its lusts, but he who does God’s will remains forever.
so whatever we ask, we receive from him, because we keep his commandments and do the things that are pleasing in his…
This is his commandment, that we should believe in the name of his Son, Jesus Christ, and love one another, even as he…

parallels.note: For whoever does the will of my Father who is in heaven, he is my brother, and sister, and mother.”

translations.web: For whoever does the will of God is my brother, my sister, and mother.”
translations.bsb: For whoever does the will of God is My brother and sister and mother.”
translations.kjv: For whosoever shall do the will of God, the same is my brother, and my sister, and mother.
